|strategy=By [mailto:bobafett@powerup.com.au Michael Sharp], Gold 29<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20001010191630/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/dark/small/reactorterminal.html</ref>

No tournament-level deck should be complete with at least 1 copy of this card in your deck. 2 copies is even better!

Allowing you to return cards from your hand to the top of your Used Pile (during your [[Control]] Phase) just before a victory, you are able to improve your winning differential.

This card is also useful to return multiple copies of one card back to protect yourself from cards such as [[Grimtaash]], or allow you to return high destiny value cards back into circulation in the hopes they will come up later on.
